data.body_html:
Planning a group trip to Marbella and wondering what the Puerto Banús yacht charter cost per person 2027 really looks like? You've come to the right place. We break down the exact numbers per person for our Tier A and Tier B boats, with no hidden fees, no surprises. All charters depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT. Whether you're a couple or a group of 12, here's what you'll actually pay.

Puerto Banús yacht charter cost per person 2027: Tier A boats

Our Tier A boats are the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). Both depart from Puerto Banús and include everything: skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% IVA. No extra charges for fuel or crew.

  • 2-hour charter: €749 total → €83/person (9 pax)
  • 4-hour charter: €1,149 total → €128/person (9 pax)
  • 6-hour charter: €1,749 total → €194/person (9 pax)
  • 8-hour charter: €2,299 total → €192/person (12 pax)

Note: the per-person cost drops significantly when you fill the boat. For 8 hours, the price per person is actually lower than for 6 hours because we allow up to 12 passengers on the 8-hour booking.

Puerto Banús yacht charter cost per person 2027: Tier B boats

Our Tier B boats include the Mangusta 80 (white and grey variants, 24m, 12 pax) and the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax). These larger, more luxurious vessels start at a 4-hour minimum charter.

  • 4-hour charter: €4,719 total → €393/person (12 pax)
  • 6-hour charter: price on request via WhatsApp
  • 8-hour charter: price on request via WhatsApp

Tier B charters include a free jet ski, plus all the usual inclusions: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. Contact us for longer durations.

Other boats: pricing on request

For boats like the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax), Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax), or the Lagoon 380 catamaran (11.6m, 10 pax), pricing is available on request. These boats offer different layouts and amenities, so contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date and group size.

Hidden costs: what's not included?

There are no hidden costs. The price you see includes every mandatory expense: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and Spanish VAT (21%). The only optional extra is a gratuity for the crew, typically 10–15% if you're satisfied. Transport to Puerto Banús is not included, but taxis and Ubers are plentiful from Marbella centre (€15–€25).

How to save per person on your yacht charter

To get the lowest per-person rate:

  • Fill the boat: the more passengers, the lower the per-person cost. Tier A boats max out at 12 pax for 8-hour charters.
  • Book a full day: 8-hour charters offer the best value per person.
  • Go mid-week: demand is lower Monday–Thursday, so availability is better, though prices are fixed.
  • Share with friends: split the cost among your group to keep it affordable.

For example, an 8-hour charter on an Azimut 39 costs €2,299 total. Split among 12 people, that's just €192/person for a full day on the water with drinks and snacks included.

What you get for your money

Every charter includes:

  • Licensed, experienced skipper
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

You can bring your own food and extra drinks at no extra charge. There is no corkage fee.

Ready to book?

Now that you know the Puerto Banús yacht charter cost per person 2027, it's time to secure your date. Contact us via WhatsApp or through our yacht charter booking page to check availability. A 50% deposit is required to confirm, with the balance due 48 hours before departure. We accept bank transfer, credit card, or cash.
